name: ChurchOS
shortDescription: New UK church-management platform combining member records, rotas, sermons, communications, events and Gift Aid administration.
suitableContexts: UK churches seeking a new all-in-one administration platform
Churches willing to trial an early-stage supplier before migrating live records

pricing.summary: ChurchOS publishes monthly GBP plans from £29 for up to 50 members to £249 for unlimited multi-site use, with a 14-day trial. The public pricing page currently contains a few plan-label inconsistencies, so obtain the current order summary before purchase.
pricing.trialDetails: The supplier advertises a 14-day free trial.

gdprInformation: The supplier footer refers to a privacy policy and terms of service. A church should obtain and assess the current data-processing, retention, subprocessor and export arrangements before providing member or donor data.
coreFeatures: Gift Aid declaration and claim workflow
importExport: Supplier advertises a paid migration service for member records, giving history and Gift Aid declarations
support: Priority support on the published Impact plan
Dedicated account manager on the published Network plan

uk-operator.value: ChurchOS identifies itself as a product of Lyrion Ltd, and Companies House records Lyrion Ltd as an active England-and-Wales company.

pricing.value: Supplier publishes four monthly GBP plans from £29 to £249 and a 14-day free trial.

gift-aid.value: Supplier describes Gift Aid declaration collection, eligible-giving tracking and R68 filing in its product and pricing material.

editorial.assessment: ChurchOS is a very new UK all-in-one product with an unusually broad published scope, covering membership, rotas, content, events and Gift Aid workflows. Its current website gives useful price and feature detail, but churches should treat a real operational trial and careful contract review as essential before moving sensitive records.
bestFor: Churches wanting to evaluate an all-in-one UK administration product from a newly incorporated supplier
Teams able to run a controlled pilot before a migration
strengths: Published GBP prices, member limits and trial
Broad connected workflow spanning members, rotas, content and events
Supplier identifies a current UK company
limitations: Very new supplier with no established public operating record
Public plan labels and included-feature lists require clarification at ordering
Churches should obtain current contractual, privacy, data-export and Gift Aid-process detail before live use

procurementVerdict.problem: A church seeking one new platform for several administrative and ministry workflows
procurementVerdict.differentiator: Supplier combines member administration, content tools, rotas, events and Gift Aid workflows in one published offer
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Run a controlled trial using real rota, event, member-access and finance-report scenarios before migrating data

seo.title: ChurchOS review for UK churches
seo.description: Independent ChurchOS profile for UK churches: published plans, all-in-one feature scope, Gift Aid claims and practical checks.
